title: The planner's image tool skips pictures of declared stock screens and opens every other picture
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A kit with no site.stockScreens opens every picture as before.
Declared stock screens' pictures answer STOCK_SCREEN; the home page's own picture still opens.

tests: a kit that declares no stock screens opens every picture as before
pictures of declared stock screens are not opened; every other picture still is
